name: DEI lender Solidex LP oracle balance-based collateral valuation
summary: The Solidex DEI/USDC LP oracle used by DeiLenderSolidex priced LP collateral from the Solidly pair's live token balances and getAmountOut quote, and checked the Muon-signed price only against that same on-chain value. With flash-borrowed USDC the attacker pushed the pair, inflating its LP collateral's value, borrowed 17.2M unbacked DEI and sold it.
notes: The oracle was deployed earlier, but the lender only started reading it when its owner 0xef6b0872 called setOracle (slot 7, previously empty after the old oracle 0x7d907cf1); that price-source switch is the latest change the exploit needed (rules 10-11).

Unbacked DEI has no usable price, so the loss is what the attacker realised: USDC from five sales into the Solidly DEI/USDC pair and two redemptions at the DEUS redemption contract 0x9bd5cc54 (the refs), at par. A DEI/USDC LP round trip is excluded; the attacker's 0.93 Solidex LP left as collateral is not netted.

Separate incident from the March 2022 lender/oracle (0xec1fc572/0x5ceb2b03): different deployments fixed and redeployed in between. No other borrow through a contract caller minted material DEI before or after the anchor.
